other_conditions: Regular conduct of elections to Panchayats or local rural bodies in non‑Part IX areas.
At least one‑third reservation for women in Panchayats.
Constitution of State Finance Committee (SFC) every five years and placement of its Action Taken Report (ATR) in the State legislature.
Constitution of District Planning Committees (DPCs) in all districts and issuance of functional guidelines/rules.
Preparation and submission of a detailed annual State Capacity Building Plan for PRIs to the Ministry of Panchayati Raj.
Co‑location of Common Service Centres (CSCs) with Gram Panchayat buildings wherever feasible.
Mapping of functional CSCs co‑located within GP buildings as an initial step.
benefits_summary: Provides capacity building, infrastructure development, IT‑enabled services, and technical support to Panchayati Raj Institutions for improved governance and local development.
